summary: Military aircraft, including fast jets, conducting high energy manoeuvres within 15 nautical miles of Tain, up to 24,500 ft, Monday to Thursday 12:00-20:00.
text:
MIL ACFT, INCLUDING FAST JETS, WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEVRES
WI 15NM RADIUS OF 574842N 0040314W (TAIN). ACFT MAY BE UNABLE TO
COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01343 817218. AR-2026-11230/01.
